mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, detail, is_default, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{detail}, #{isDefault}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
